newsitem.title: UK: L&G, Pru dip after Q2 figures.
newsitem.headline: L&G, Pru dip after Q2 figures.

text.p: Shares in British insurance groups Legal & General Plc and Prudential Corp Plc fell on Wednesday after second quarter figures disappointed the market, analysts said.
L&G fell 4-1/2p to 429-1/2p and Prudential 1-1/2p to 611-1/2p by 0829 GMT.

"What we're seeing is a flatter second quarter after an absolutely staggering first quarter which built up people's expectations. General expectations were that things were growing again but it seems now to be more a case of recovery than growth," said Goldman Sachs analyst Stephen Dias.

L&G said first half new UK equivalent premium income rose 24 percent to 175 million stg. Prudential said worldwide first half sales rose 23 percent to 3.6 billion stg. Regular premium sales was up 20 percent to 294 million stg.
"No one expected second quarter to be as good as the first quarter but this (today's figures) means we've come back to a low, single digit growth rate again," said Dias.
